name: Paciolan / eVenue Seat Collector
description: Reads the rendered eVenue (Paciolan) seat map in your real Chrome and ships a normalized seat/section snapshot — plus the full raw page + inline JSON (format-drift safety net) — to our own ingest endpoint. Optional autonomous driver polls a SQL pull queue and refreshes due events on its own. READ-ONLY: only reads the DOM the page already rendered; never issues any POST/hold/order to an evenue.net host.
